title: Toilet Paper Stand 27-Inch Solid Brass Euro Hook | Oil Rubbed Bronze | Carolina | Allied Brass
short_title: Toilet Paper Stand 27-Inch, Oil Rubbed Bronze
description:
Need a toilet paper holder without drilling into the wall? This freestanding toilet paper stand gives you a stable, space-saving way to keep a roll within easy reach—ideal when wall space is limited in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom.

Highlights:
- Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Coordinates with other Carolina pieces for a distinguished, heritage-inspired look
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Coordinate a cohesive look; part of the Carolina Collection for matching Carolina accessories
- Built for lasting everyday use; crafted from solid brass construction

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: Freestanding toilet paper stand (Euro-style)
- Material: Solid brass
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 8 in. x 27 in. x 6 in.
- Assembly: Some assembly required
Multiple designer finish options available
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
